column2: The show is a parody of old detective films, copying their style to make viewers laugh.
column3: 這個節目是老偵探片的戲仿，模仿其風格來逗觀眾發笑。
column4: parody of a film (電影的戲仿)
column5: par 旁邊 + ody 歌：在原作旁邊唱的搞笑版
column8: 諧仿；戲仿；幽默摹擬

column2: George Orwell's Animal Farm is an allegory in which farm animals stand for political leaders.
column3: 歐威爾的《動物農莊》是一則寓言，書中的農場動物象徵政治領袖。
column5: alle 另外 + gory 說：嘴上說這個，意思指另一個
column8: 寓言；諷喻；象徵比喻小說

column2: In the parable of the lost sheep, a shepherd searches for one animal to teach the value of every person.
column3: 在迷途羔羊的寓言中，牧羊人尋找一隻羊，藉此教導每個人都有價值。
column5: parable 與 parabola 拋物線同根「並排」：把故事放在道理旁邊比較
column8: 道德或宗教啟發的小寓言

column2: The fable of the tortoise and the hare teaches that slow, steady effort can beat quick but careless speed.
column3: 龜兔賽跑的寓言教導我們，緩慢而穩定的努力能勝過快速卻粗心的速度。
column5: fable 想成 fabulous 神奇：動物會說話的神奇故事
column8: 擬人動物寓言；寓意故事

column2: The irony of the story is that the firefighter's own kitchen caught fire on the day he won a safety award.
column3: 這個故事的諷刺之處在於，消防員獲頒安全獎的那天，他自己的廚房卻失火了。
column5: irony 諧音「愛弱你」：口說愛你，事實卻相反
column8: 反諷；語意反轉；情境諷刺

column2: Time is a thief is a metaphor that makes hours seem like something stolen from us.
column3: 「時間是小偷」是一個隱喻，使時光彷彿是被偷走的東西。
column5: meta 轉換 + phor 帶：把意思帶到別的事物上
column8: 隱喻；暗喻；深層象徵指涉

column2: Her smile was as bright as the sun is a simile because it compares two things using "as".
column3: 「她的笑容像太陽一樣明亮」是明喻，因為它用「as」來比較兩種事物。
column5: simile 與 similar 相似同家族：用 like 或 as 說「像」
column8: 明喻；直接以 like 或 as 比擬

column2: Saying "I've told you a million times" is hyperbole, because no one has repeated anything that often.
column3: 說「我已經告訴你一百萬次了」是誇飾，因為沒有人會把一件事重複那麼多次。
column5: hyper 超過 + bole 投擲：話丟得太遠了
column8: 誇飾；修辭誇張；強化手法

column2: Personification appears in the line "the wind whispered through the trees," which gives the wind a human voice.
column3: 擬人化出現在「風在樹間低語」這句話中，它賦予風人類的聲音。
column4: personification of nature (自然的擬人化)
column5: person 人 + ify 使成為 + tion：把東西變成人
column7: per - son - i - fi - ca - tion
column8: 擬人化；賦予無生命者情感

column2: Peter Piper picked a peck uses alliteration, repeating the starting sound of nearby words.
column3: 「Peter Piper picked a peck」使用了頭韻，重複相鄰單字開頭的子音。
column5: al 向 + liter 字母：連著用同一個字母開頭
column8: 頭韻；押同一個字首子音

column2: The word "buzz" is onomatopoeia because it copies the sound a bee makes.
column3: 「buzz」這個字是擬聲詞，因為它模仿蜜蜂發出的聲音。
column4: example of onomatopoeia (擬聲詞的例子)
column5: onoma 名字 + poeia 製造：造個名字模仿聲音，像「嗡嗡」
column7: on - o - mat - o - poe - i - a
column8: 擬聲詞；摹仿大自然聲音

column2: Medieval tales of chivalry describe knights who protected the weak and spoke politely to everyone.
column3: 中世紀的騎士精神故事描述保護弱者、對每個人都彬彬有禮的騎士。
column4: code of chivalry (騎士精神守則)
column5: chival 像法文 cheval 馬：騎在馬上的騎士風範
column8: 中世紀騎士精神；俠義風範

column2: A troubadour traveled from castle to castle, singing love songs he had composed himself.
column3: 一位吟遊詩人從一座城堡走到另一座城堡，唱著自己創作的情歌。
column5: troubadour 諧音「吹爸都兒」：吹著琴到處唱歌
column8: 中世紀吟遊詩人；走唱樂師

column2: Empirical research relies on measurements and observations rather than on theory alone.
column3: 實證研究依賴測量與觀察，而不是只依賴理論。
column5: em 在內 + peir 試驗：親身試過才算數
column8: 實證的；以經驗觀察為依據的

column2: Before the experiment, the student wrote a hypothesis predicting that plants with more light would grow taller.
column3: 實驗之前，學生寫下一個假說，預測光照較多的植物會長得較高。
column5: hypo 在下 + thesis 論點：放在底下、等著被檢驗的想法
column8: 科學假說；待驗前提假定

column2: In the experiment, temperature was the only variable, so any change in growth could be linked to it.
column3: 在實驗中，溫度是唯一的變數，因此任何生長上的變化都能歸因於它。
column5: vary 變化 + able 可以：可以變動的那個東西

column2: The independent variable was the amount of fertilizer, which the researcher changed on purpose.
column3: 自變數是肥料的用量，由研究者刻意改變。
column4: manipulate the independent variable (操縱自變數)
column5: independent 獨立：不受影響，由研究者自己決定
column7: in - de - pen - dent var - i - a - ble

column2: The dependent variable was plant height, which changed according to how much fertilizer the plants received.
column3: 應變數是植物高度，它隨植物獲得多少肥料而改變。
column4: measure the dependent variable (測量應變數)
column5: depend 依靠：要看自變數臉色，跟著變
column7: de - pen - dent var - i - a - ble

column2: Patients in the control group received an ordinary pill so researchers could compare them with the treated patients.
column3: 對照組的病人服用普通藥丸，使研究者能將他們與接受治療的病人比較。
column5: control 控制 + group 組：什麼都不改的基準組

column2: The experimental group studied with the new app for a month, while the other students used textbooks.
column3: 實驗組用新的應用程式學習一個月，其他學生則使用課本。
column4: join the experimental group (加入實驗組)
column5: experiment 實驗 + al：被動手處理的那一組
column7: ex - per - i - men - tal group

column2: Other labs tried to replicate the finding, but none could get the same result.
column3: 其他實驗室試圖重複這項發現，但沒有任何一間能得到相同結果。
column4: replicate a study (重複一項研究)
column5: re 再 + plic 摺疊：再折一次，再做一次
column8: 重複實驗；再現結果；複製

column2: Replication is crucial in science, because a result seen only once may be a mistake.
column3: 再現性在科學中至關重要，因為只出現一次的結果可能是錯誤。
column5: replicate 加 tion：同一個實驗，再做一次
column8: 實驗再現性；獨立重驗能力

column2: Physicists derive the formula by starting from basic laws and following each logical step.
column3: 物理學家從基本定律出發，循著每個邏輯步驟推導出這個公式。
column5: de 來自 + riv 河流：水從河的源頭流下來
column8: 推導出；由…衍生；獲得公式

column2: The student connected a tube, a flask, and a heater into one apparatus to warm the liquid safely.
column3: 學生把管子、燒瓶和加熱器接成一套裝置，以便安全地加熱液體。
column5: ap 朝向 + parat 準備：為實驗準備好的整套器材
column8: 整套實驗儀器；裝置

column2: One strange measurement stood out as an anomaly, far from the pattern in all the other data.
column3: 有一筆怪異的測量值格外突出，是個反常現象，遠離其他所有數據的模式。
column5: an 不 + omal 平整：不平整、不合群的異常
column8: 反常現象；異常數據；離群值

column2: The anomalous result puzzled scientists, because it broke a rule that had worked for a hundred years.
column3: 這個反常的結果讓科學家很困惑，因為它違反了沿用一百年的規律。
column5: anomaly 加 ous 變形容詞：不合常理的
column8: 反常的；不合常理規律的

column2: A strong correlation links ice cream sales and sunburns, though neither one causes the other.
column3: 冰淇淋銷量與曬傷之間有很強的相關性，雖然兩者並不互為因果。
column5: cor 一起 + relation 關係：一起變動的關係
column8: 統計相關性；相互關聯

column2: Correlation alone cannot prove causation; researchers must show that one event actually produces the other.
column3: 僅靠相關性不能證明因果關係；研究者必須證明一件事確實造成另一件事。
column5: cause 原因 + ation：誰是因、誰是果
column8: 因果關係；因果必然連結

column2: The scale measures weight to a precision of one hundredth of a gram, giving nearly the same value each time.
column3: 這台秤能以百分之一公克的精密度測量重量，每次都得到幾乎相同的數值。
column5: pre 前 + cis 切：切得又細又齊，每次都一樣
column8: 精密度；多次量測的一致性

column2: The thermometer reads five degrees too high, so although it is consistent, its accuracy is poor.
column3: 這支溫度計讀數高了五度，所以雖然穩定一致，準確度卻很差。
column5: accuracy 是靠近靶心，precision 是落點集中
column8: 準確度；接近真實值的程度

column2: Technicians calibrate the scale each morning so that its readings match known weights.
column3: 技術人員每天早上校準磅秤，使讀數與已知重量相符。
column5: calibrate 結尾 -ate 是動詞：把刻度調到準
column8: 校準；校正儀器使量測精確

column2: Regular calibration keeps the pressure gauge accurate so factory workers can trust its numbers.
column3: 定期校準使壓力計保持準確，工廠員工才能信任它的數字。
column5: calibrate 加 tion：把刻度調準的那個動作
column8: 校準作業；刻度校正

column2: The researchers set one parameter, the water temperature, and left every other condition unchanged.
column3: 研究人員設定一個參數，也就是水溫，並讓其他所有條件保持不變。
column5: para 旁邊 + meter 測量：測量時要先定好的界線
column8: 決定性參數；變數範圍界線

column2: The biologist placed a leaf specimen under the lens to study its tiny veins.
column3: 生物學家把一片葉子標本放在鏡片下，研究它細小的葉脈。
column5: spec 看，像 inspect 檢查：拿來給人仔細看的樣本
column8: 生物標本；化學檢體；取樣

column2: Through the microscope, the students saw tiny cells moving inside a drop of pond water.
column3: 透過顯微鏡，學生看見一滴池水中有微小的細胞在移動。
column5: micro 微小 + scope 看：看微小東西的鏡子
column8: 顯微鏡；放大觀察的光學儀器

column2: The technician spun the blood sample in a centrifuge until the heavier parts settled at the bottom.
column3: 技術員把血液樣本放進離心機旋轉，直到較重的部分沉到底部。
column4: spin in a centrifuge (在離心機中旋轉)
column5: centri 中心 + fuge 逃離：東西被甩離中心

column2: The chemist added a reagent to the clear liquid, and it instantly turned pink.
column3: 化學家在澄清的液體中加入一種試劑，它立刻變成粉紅色。
column5: re 反應 + agent 劑：引發反應的藥劑
column8: 化學試劑；檢驗反應物

column2: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen, and it behaves unlike either gas alone.
column3: 水是氫與氧組成的化合物，其性質和任何一種氣體單獨存在時都不同。
column5: com 一起 + pound 放置：把元素放在一起
column8: 化合物；純淨的化合物質

column2: As the solute, sugar disappears into the tea, breaking into particles too small to see.
column3: 作為溶質，糖溶入茶中，分解成小到看不見的微粒。
column5: solu 和 solve 解開同家族：被解開溶掉的東西

column2: Water is called the universal solvent because it can dissolve more substances than most other liquids.
column3: 水被稱為萬用溶劑，因為它能溶解的物質比大多數其他液體更多。
column5: solve 解開 + ent：能把東西解開的液體
